name: review-real-diffs
summary: Render real diff text in review, with line-anchored comments
body:
The review pane listed hunk metadata without a single line of code.
Patches now load on change selection via a new ism:hunks channel
(`ism show hunk`), rendered side-by-side or unified from a parsed-and-
tested diff module. Clicking a new-side line number anchors the next
comment to path:line — the same anchor `ism comment add --path --line`
records — and the newest stack change auto-selects so review starts
at the top.
